images.title: Ten ones carry to the tens line
images.purpose: Shows the carry on the counting board when adding 2907 and 43: 7 ones and 3 ones make 10 ones, which become one counter on the tens line.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. Four horizontal lines stacked like a ladder, counters on them, a loop around the ones and a curved arrow up to the tens line.
images.exact_structure: Four long horizontal dark lines, labelled at the left from top to bottom: 1000, 100, 10, 1. On the 1000 line: exactly 2 teal (#0072B2) counters. On the 100 line: exactly 4 teal counters on the line and 1 teal counter just above the line. On the 10 line: exactly 4 teal counters and 1 reddish purple (#CC79A7) counter at the end. On the 1 line: exactly 10 pale grey (#6B7280) ghost counters (thin outline, faint fill, the traded ones), all 10 ringed by one reddish purple loop labelled 10 ones. One curved reddish purple arrow from the loop up to the reddish purple counter on the 10 line, labelled 1 ten. Exactly 22 counters, 10 of them pale ghosts, so the solid counters read 2950. Nothing else in the frame.

images.takeaway: Ten counters on a line become one counter on the next line up.
images.description: Shows the carry on the counting board when adding 2907 and 43: 7 ones and 3 ones make 10 ones, which become one counter on the tens line.
images.context: Worked example: 2907 + 43 = 2950; a counter above a line is worth 5 of that line.

image_decisions.why: The board shows carrying as a physical move of counters between lines.
